originalReview.notes: Exact full2915x3782Qualla-published LuigiPesce/METCC0recto inspected: roofless hollow brick cylinder, sharply angled vertical buttresses, pointed entrance surround and several interlocking pointed-niche/corbel rows at the crown. Its originalKufic/erodedbasecondition predates restorations and is not copied as a modern state. Exact1728x1996Qualla-published1840PascalCostePD-oldplan/details inspected: circular inner chamber(10.70mannotation), thick star-fluted wall/entrance and brick bond. Conjectural TOUR RESTAUREEview/dome is expressly excluded, not treated as surviving geometry. Local story says24angles; native relation gives20mheight and original outer/inner rings, matching inner diameter. The similarly named MET_DP202957image is the blank annotated verso, not a second architecture view, and is excluded. FlandinYezid/Rheyviews are not needed; no identity assumption is adopted from them. No modern attribution/share-alike or supplemental photograph used.
